scope: Ten reference-faithful card backings and live review previews; no automatic dashboard replacement

params.prompt: REFERENCE-FAITHFUL UI FRAME EXTRACTION — Welcome card. The supplied crop is the exact master for this ONE card. Produce ONE isolated BLANK decorative card backing, preserving its original silhouette, width-to-height proportions, border thicknesses, corner steps, folds, divider placement, colours and hard offset shadow. Preserve the wine title band, vanilla body, clipped lower-right corner and original outer border. Remove the Elmina illustration because the already approved separate illustration will be overlaid live. Remove ALL text, numbers, letters, icons, photographs and illustrations, including tiny Sample data text. Reconstruct clean surface underneath removed content. Do not create a dashboard, a collage, a second card, a caption, a label, a logo or any new ornament. The retained frame is decorative; real text, numbers, illustrations and controls will be overlaid in code. Use only wine #6C1A21, cherry #B92C2C, gold #CEA257, sand #D1BF9A and vanilla #E5E0CD. Flat crisp pixel-sticker edges; no blur, no glow, no gradients, no perspective. Preserve this crop's card proportions independently of the output canvas: center the whole card with transparent padding wherever needed, never stretch it to fill the canvas. True alpha transparency outside its silhouette. Keep the entire border, shadow, folds and bookmarks inside the output without clipping.
